title: Epicrispr Biotechnologies and Forge Biologics Announce AAV Development and cGMP Manufacturing Partnership
llm_note: Epicrispr and Forge Biologics formed a partnership for the cGMP manufacturing of an AAV gene therapy.

title: BioNTech to slash 1,860 jobs, exit sites in Germany and Singapore in major manufacturing pullback
llm_note: BioNTech is closing manufacturing sites in Germany and Singapore, resulting in 1,860 job cuts.

title: Novartis to close German manufacturing site, cutting 220 jobs
llm_note: Novartis plans to close its production facility in Wehr, Germany, by 2028.

title: VectorBuilder Secures European Patent for MiniVec™, a Plasmid Backbone Advancing Safety and Manufacturability in Genetic Medicine
llm_note: VectorBuilder received a patent for a plasmid system designed to improve genetic medicine manufacturing scalability.

title: Bracco Launches BubbleGen™ Early Access Program for Microbubble-Based Cell Selection and Activation at ISCT
llm_note: Bracco launched an early access program for microbubble technology to streamline cell therapy manufacturing processes.
